title: BridgeWorks Campus
one_line: Walk the campus road from Class 1 to Expert Engineer: answer your class's questions to earn parts, then build a real-physics bridge and test it with traffic.
how_to_play: Pick your class, tap its building, answer questions to earn parts, tap two joints to place a member, then press Test bridge. Guide, Hint and Show me lead you step by step; Forces shows the pushes and pulls at any joint.
description: Sixteen buildings on one road: Class 1 to 12, BE, NIT, IIT and Expert Engineer. Each building has only its own question bank (53,000+ questions: physics, chemistry, maths, biology, EVS, computer, commerce, economics, engineering and a bridge quiz for every project) and its own bridge to build, from a simple cable bridge for Class 1-7 to a two-pylon convoy bridge for IIT and Expert. A real stiffness-method truss solver checks every member for snapping, crushing and buckling as the vehicle drives across, and force arrows show the physics at any joint. English and Bengali, questions read aloud for Class 1-3, guided steps, hints, stars, unlocks, badges, a daily streak, a weekly bridge challenge and a printable report card for teachers. Works offline once loaded; nothing is tracked.
